name: EXTR01 reference set
note: Answers from the manual pages (not from the graph). `expect` lists the facts an answer must state; each fact is a list of accepted spellings. First used 2026-10-16 (session log 147).

questions.question: What is the regreasing interval and grease amount for the ball bearings of the extruder main motor?
questions.answer: 5,600 h and 70 g per bearing (frame 355, 4-pole, 1500 r/min; 4,000 h at 1800 r/min)
questions.source: Low voltage motors manual 3GZF500730-85, Table 7.2, p.20

questions.question: The extruder motor stalls. What are the possible causes and what should I do?
questions.answer: One phase may be open: check lines; wrong application: change type or size; overload: reduce load; low voltage: keep the rating plate voltage; open circuit: fuses blown, check overload relay, stator and push buttons
questions.source: Low voltage motors manual 3GZF500730-85, Table 10.1, p.24

questions.question: What grease should be used to regrease the extruder motor bearings?
questions.answer: Lithium complex soap with mineral or PAO oil, base oil 100-160 cSt at 40 °C, NLGI 1.5-3, -30 to +120 °C

questions.question: The extruder motor is a standby motor in a vibrating environment. How often must its shaft be rotated?
questions.answer: Every 2 weeks by starting the system; if not possible, turned by hand once a week

questions.question: The main drive shows fault 2340 Short circuit. What does it mean and what should I check?
questions.answer: Short circuit in the motor cable(s) or motor; check cabling, 95.04 Control board supply, 99.10 Motor nominal power, no PF correction capacitors or surge absorbers, auxiliary code
questions.source: ACS880 Primary control program firmware manual, p.580

questions.question: The main drive shows warning A581 Fan. What does it mean and what should I do?
questions.answer: Cooling fan feedback missing; check 95.20 HW options word 1 bit 14, identify the fan by the auxiliary code, check and replace the fan
questions.source: ACS880 Primary control program firmware manual, p.601

questions.question: What should I do when the main drive reports an Internal SSW fault?
questions.answer: 64B1 internal fault: reboot the control unit (96.08 Control board boot) or cycle power; if it persists, contact ABB
questions.source: ACS880 Primary control program firmware manual, p.590

questions.question: What frame size is the main drive frequency converter, and when should its main cooling fans be replaced?
questions.answer: Frame R11 (ACS880-07-0880A-3); main cooling fan replaced at 9 and 18 years from start-up
questions.source: ACS880-07 hardware manual, p.215 (ratings) and p.176 (maintenance intervals)

questions.question: How often does the steam valve actuator (Spiratrol EL5000) need maintenance, and with which lubricant?
questions.answer: Gear lubrication about every three years, or after about 200,000 double strokes under heavy use; Klueber Mikrolube GL261
